action_instruction: Extracting the board request inventory from the dashboard posts list
intent: the complete request inventory of titles and statuses in Acme's dashboard Posts list

action_params.condition: the complete board request inventory from Acme's dashboard post list (inbox), including each request's title and status, is stored as {{board_request_inventory}}
action_params.query: the complete request inventory of titles and statuses in Acme's dashboard Posts list
action_params.code_js: JSON.stringify(Array.from(el(30).querySelectorAll(':scope > li'), li => { const link = li.querySelector('a'); const status = li.querySelector('[role="combobox"]'); return {title: link ? link.innerText.trim() : '', status: status ? status.innerText.trim() : ''}; }))
